firstPlayerRule: The player who last had a colored drink starts.
clarifications: Place apprentices on unoccupied starting spaces in turn, then keep the same turn order.
For 2 or 3 players, use the board side with three apprentice symbols; for 4 players, use the side with four.
When completed potions cause movement, the active player moves first. Eligible other players then move clockwise, beginning with the active player’s left neighbor.
The worked example passes the next normal turn to the active player’s left neighbor. Cauldron rotation instructions are separate from player order.
The game ends immediately when an apprentice leaves the cave; that player wins. Do not finish the round.
